title: Actuator repair: expose the working wall and renew the backing
status_authority: Supplied available rendered return and ROOT introduced contracts at exact scopes; earlier accepted source-bound results remain unchanged. No Capital scientific execution, physical qualification or new independent audit.
reported_status: P2 designs a rolling pneumatic wall with separate working, repair and backing-cleaning configurations, including finite load isolation, generic-film patching, cooling, observations, proof and stock renewal. Introduced models predict21N through22mm,443.7s complete repair and1851J at25C, with1969J in a sampled cold case. They supply zero physically accepted repairs; repaired-film fatigue, tooling release, installed observations and repeated access remain unqualified. The strongest prepared-liner exchanger is cheaper per potential work; the full sustained self-maintenance and advantage targets are unachieved. ROOT adds a material-destination/gauge constraint, not a failure theorem.

Guided rolling actuator with nominal38um film,52mm piston,60mm guide,4mm rolling gap,22mm useful stroke and two paid service overtravels. Retain customer load with a separate brake/catch, vent, park captive cap, enforce actual unloaded folds, place/hold/heat/cool a generic lap patch, expose and clean worked backing, withdraw all tools, then prove useful loaded work and renewed access. Admitted missing-material geometry and loose dust envelope are finite; arbitrary cavities, oils, cuff cuts and machinery damage are excluded.

proof_availability.classification_scope: No19/20 accepted hardware repairs or100-hour self-maintenance demonstration. Parent tensile strength is not repaired-film fatigue or weld toughness; pressure/force passes do not identify buried weak bonds. Fold following, release coating, camera localization and tool recovery are actual missing operations. A few grams of prepared spare films challenge inventory/mass claims. Current model cost is15.7% higher per potential work than the strongest exchanger; no30% or threefold whole-system advantage. ROOT stiffness/strain screens are introduced small-strain diagnostics, not a TPU failure prediction.
